question: In which of the following years was the 'National Institution for Transforming India' established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog)** was established by the Government of India **on January 1, 2015**, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• NITI Aayog acts as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, providing strategic and technical advice on developmental matters.
